quest.title: Crash Course on Inazuman Fashion
quest.description: Ogura Mio, the owner of Ogura Textiles & Kimonos, is rather anxious about something...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: This is no way to continue doing business...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I was just a little lost in my own thoughts. Are you here to buy some clothes?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: The high-class silks from Liyue remain out of stock, but we still have the latest kimonos.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You used to import material from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Yes. Before, we were often able to secure high-end silk from Liyue such as those that the Feiyun Commerce Guild makes from Silk Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: But with the current situation here, we haven't been able to import that sort of silk in a while now. We've been having to rely on our existing stock to continue operations.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Every bolt of silk we use here is one we're not getting back...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I originally planned to design some novel kimono patterns myself, or use some new dyes to make new cloth and attract customers.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: But I've been unable to come up with anything that might be considered "new" dyes...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Considering your many journeys, Traveler, I'm sure you've seen a great deal. Have you encountered any dye-work that you might consider "novel"?

response.speaker: Ogura Mio
response.text: If you could, please help me broaden my horizons. Find me some base materials from which I can might new types of dye.

response.speaker: Ogura Mio
response.text: I will take care of the payment. Again, thank you so much!

response.speaker: Ogura Mio
response.text: In these circumstances, I think that's the only thing I can do at the moment...

response.speaker: Ogura Mio
response.text: If you know of any such base material that can be used to make "new" dyes, please bring them to me. I'll arrange for the necessary payment.

talks.objective: Give the appropriate dye ingredients to Ogura Mio

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's what you've brought. Yes, yes, I do think that these colors will be quite the novelty indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for getting me these, Traveler. I'll give them a try in a moment — please take this as compensation for your efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I wonder what colors we'll be able to get...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Th—these... Are you sure that these can be used in dyes? I can't say I've ever heard of them...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: O—Oh well, I suppose I'll just give it a go. Here, Traveler, take these as a token of my appreciation...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Have you found any suitable base materials?
